subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence.

Rather than being deceitful, we need to be __truthful__ and work together to stop the unrestrained growth of corruption in all areas of our society.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Deceitful.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined word **"truthful"** means telling the truth; honest. (सच्चा)

 
 
• **Example:** To resolve the conflict, being truthful about the events that transpired is essential.
 
 
 
• The antonym **"deceitful"** means dishonest or intended to make someone believe something that is not true. (धोखेबाज)
 
 
• **Example: **The deceitful tactics used by the company to mislead consumers were eventually exposed.
 
 
 
• As we can see, the antonym of **'truthful'** is **'deceitful'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is- **Deceitful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2, **"Growth"**, pertains to the process of increasing in size, number, value, or strength. (वृद्धि)
 
• Option 3,** "Unrestrained"**, means not restrained or restricted. (अनियंत्रित)
 
• Option 4, **"Stop"**, means to bring to an end; halt. (बंद करना)
